commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Michael Oliver has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Substitution. Nehemiah Oriola (Brighton) replaces Georginio Rutter.
90+4' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Joe Knight (Brighton) replacing Yasin Ayari.
90+2' Leeds take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+2' Leeds work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
88' Substitution. Yankuba Minteh makes way for Charalampos Kostoulas (Brighton).
86' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Leeds will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

85' Lukas Nmecha (Leeds) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom left corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Bart Verbruggen, who tips the ball around the post.
82' Here is a change. Danny Welbeck is going off and Fabian Hurzeler gives the last tactical orders to Stefanos Tzimas (Brighton).
81' Substitution. Diego Gomez will be replaced by Tom Watson (Brighton).
81' The referee awards a corner and Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) goes over to take it.
80' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brighton comes to nothing.
77' Daniel Farke has decided to substitute Noah Okafor and he is replaced by Jack Harrison (Leeds).
77' It will be a substitution. James Justin (Leeds) is ready to enter the pitch as Jayden Bogle walks off.
73' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) makes a really bad tackle on his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
70' 3 - 0 Diego Gomez (Brighton) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper was helpless.
69' The ball possession at the moment is 49:51.
65' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Dominic Calvert-Lewin as he is replaced by Lukas Nmecha (Leeds).
64' 2 - 0 Diego Gomez (Brighton) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to unleash a great effort which ends up in the middle of the goal.
61' Daniel Farke has decided to make a change. Daniel James (Leeds) replaces Ao Tanaka.
60' The referee allows time for a substitution. Sean Longstaff will be replaced by Anton Stach (Leeds).
59' The corner kick from Sean Longstaff (Leeds) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

58' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot on goal, but the ball curls just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
57' A loose ball is pounced on by Diego Gomez (Brighton) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Lucas Perri is alert and makes a comfortable save.
52' Noah Okafor (Leeds) sends a chip pass into the box, but Bart Verbruggen is quickest to intercept the ball.
51' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger. The ball goes out of play and Leeds will have a goal kick.

49' What a great effort! Georginio Rutter (Brighton) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the left post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leeds.
48' The Brighton players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
48' Noah Okafor (Leeds) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.

47' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the roof of the net, but Lucas Perri shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Sean Longstaff (Leeds) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
45+1' Sean Longstaff (Leeds) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Noah Okafor (Leeds) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
43' The Leeds players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession. The linesman signals a throw-in for Brighton.

41' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leeds.
41' Brighton players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
37' A player from Brighton commits a rough challenge. Michael Oliver blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
34' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Leeds will have a goal kick.
32' Danny Welbeck received a clever long ball from Lewis Dunk (Brighton) which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert and managed to avert the threat.
31' Sean Longstaff (Leeds) prepares to take a corner kick.
30' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Noah Okafor (Leeds), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
29' Neat passing move from Leeds in order to create new attacking opportunities.
28' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
26' 51:49 – this is the current ball possession ratio.

25' Jaka Bijol (Leeds) and Gabriel Gudmundsson have been trying to find each other with some accurate passes ever since the match started. These two definitely combine the most and are the team's most creative players.
23' Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
22' Sean Longstaff (Leeds) is about to take a corner kick.
21' Sean Longstaff (Leeds) produces a shot from a long-range free kick, but it flies high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
20' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) makes a rough challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul. Leeds win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
14' Great teamplay by Brighton as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
14' The ball goes out of play. Brighton are awarded a corner kick.
11' 1 - 0 Danny Welbeck (Brighton) latches on to a precise pass inside the box and sends in a superb strike that finds its way into the middle of the net.
7' Noah Okafor (Leeds) sends a long ball forward to Jayden Bogle, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is out of play. Brighton will take a throw-in.
6' Noah Okafor (Leeds) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
3' Noah Okafor (Leeds) sends a cross into the box, but Bart Verbruggen comes off his line to gather the ball.
1' The Brighton players are exchanging some short passes.
